name: Ghost-note juke bounce
desc: Darker juke bounce: 6-over-8 polymeter kicks that drift and realign, swung elongated hats, rimshot chatter and 808 cowbell rotations at peak — a meaner sibling to the triplet grid.

code.full: s("{bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd}%8, [hh@2 hh]*4, ~ rim ~ [rim rim]").bank("RolandTR808").fast(${rate}).lastOf(8, x=>x.fast(2)).lpf(sine.range(${tone}*.6, ${tone}*1.4).slow(24)).shape(.3).gain(${gain}).room(.1).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: s("{bd ~ bd bd ~ bd}%8, [hh@2 hh]*4, cb(3,8,<0 2 4 6>), ~ rim ~ [rim rim rim]").bank("RolandTR808").fast(${rate}).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).lpf(sine.range(${tone}, ${tone}*1.8).slow(12)).shape(.35).gain(${gain}).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(16)).room(.1).orbit(1).play()
